title: feat(nm2oricycc2z): cyclic lex-smallest Orient freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: opposite z-probes, cyclic lex-smallest orientation at two cuts; hold/hold at both. Fully redundant with #7452 plus the freeze lemma. Composition is forced: O(q,tau) is constant for all tau>=t(q)+1 (any step e in O(q) requires e in M(q+e), which forces t(q+e)=t(q)+1), so t+2 can never differ from t+1 and composition=HOLD carries zero information.
